title: Polypiler spec family 'verification'
description: The body under 'spec' of a document in spec/verification/ (PRD §4.1, §7.2, §23): an input generator, the tolerance of one operation (ADR 0005) or a reference oracle. Rules the schema cannot state (PLY0046): layout, strategy-requirements, boundary-covers-extremes, value-fits-type, bound-for-mode, one-tolerance-per-operation, oracle-not-self; 'type' and 'operation' name existing documents (PLY0043).

type.description: The TYPES document the generated values belong to.

strategy.description: boundary: the explicit list 'values'; uniform: 'count' values drawn uniformly from 'seed'; bit-pattern: walking ones and zeros and alternating patterns, then random patterns from 'seed' up to 'count'; corpus: the type's values of the corpus.

values.description: The values of a boundary generator, each a bit pattern '0x…' or a decimal integer, quoted.

seed.description: The seed of the random sequence; the same seed draws the same values (PRD §23.3).

operation.description: The INTRINSICS or IR document the tolerance applies to.

mode.description: The comparison mode of ADR 0005: exact (bit patterns identical), ulp (representable values between the results), relative (difference against the reference's magnitude), absolute (difference).

bound.description: The largest admitted distance; a positive integer in 'ulp' mode, absent in 'exact' mode.

specialValues.description: The special-value rule of ADR 0005, signed-zero when absent: bitwise compares NaN sign, quiet bit and payload and tells +0 from -0; signed-zero lets any NaN equal any NaN and tells +0 from -0; class lets any NaN equal any NaN and +0 equal -0.

implementation.description: What produces the reference result: node, pb-compiler, published-vectors, … — never Polypiler itself.

toolchain.description: The key of tooling/toolchains.lock when the oracle is a tool.

observes.description: The observable behaviour the oracle reports (PRD §23.1).
